prefix_a: i gave my phone to my friend for one hour.
prefix_b: my friend gave me a phone for one hour.
human_check: The generated account should track the change in possession. Different word sequences alone do not pass the semantic check.

prefix_a: i sold the coin to pay for a place to live.
prefix_b: i kept the coin and had to leave my home.
changed_fact: The coin was sold to obtain housing versus kept while losing housing
human_check: The continuation should not assign the same sale and housing outcome to both narrators without explanation.

prefix_a: i put the broken clock on my desk instead of throwing it away.
prefix_b: i fixed the clock and put it on my desk.
changed_fact: The clock remains broken versus was repaired
human_check: Whether the clock works should remain interpretable through the continuation. A metaphor is permitted when its literal status is clear.

prefix_a: i deleted the message before anyone had read it.
prefix_b: i sent the message and my friend read it.
changed_fact: The message was unread and deleted versus delivered and read
human_check: The model should distinguish a private unsent thought from an actual exchange.
